notes:
Account background: Cascade is a fast-growing ecommerce marketplace with ~1.2k staff, contact centers in NA, EU, APAC. Already on Redwood hosted for search/embeddings in a pilot with marketing; now expanding to enterprise contact-center workloads (agent assist + live tool calls).

Key asks from last calls: 
- live agent assist must be extremely low-latency: target median end-to-end response <250ms for short prompts (context caching expected).
- ticket summarization batch jobs ok at 700ms-1s per summary; cost sensitivity for nightly summarization pipeline.
- tool-calling: webhook actions back to Zendesk/Genesys/Freshdesk + secure param injection; require signed requests and audit trail.
- reliability under spikes: Black Friday style bursts -> need autoscale + graceful degradation (fallback to smaller quantized model + cached KV responses). Need guarantee for 99th pctile SLA.
- model preference: prefer open weights where possible (Llama-family / Mistral) but will consider hosted variants for fallbacks. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization.

Quote from SVP Ops on 2026-03-04 call: "We can tolerate occasional quality drop if the agent remains productive, but we cannot have outages during peak sale windows."

POC summary: 
- 2026-02-20 kickoff (ffl-2026-02-20-8841) - scope: agent-assist + ticket-summaries for VIP queue.
- 2026-02-28 sandbox results: avg latency 210ms using hosted small-llama variant, peak degrade at 12k concurrent requests. Observed token cost > baseline; looking at dedicated GPUs + quantization.
- 2026-03-04 security sync (ffl-2026-03-04-9123) - requested KMS key flow diagram, audit log retention policy, and SOC2/ISO evidence.
- 2026-03-09 demo with Zendesk integration prototype; tool-calls working but signature flow needs Hardened HMAC + replay protection (opened INF-3421).

Recent activity: 
- 2026-03-10: internal procurement flagged for Dedicated capacity commit.
- 2026-03-11: pricing deck v3 sent to buyer (drive://redwood-sales/cascade_cc/pricing-deck-v3).

Open technical items: 
- KMS integration: SE asks for sample KMS rotate flow; security team wants HSM/KMS architecture doc.
- EU data residency: must ensure customer messages for EU agents stay in EU region (legal review).
- Autoscale policy: need clear fallback policy (which model/version for fallback, per-route throttling).

Business notes / play: prioritize Dedicated offering for headroom + private plane for EU regs. Upsell path: start Dedicated for NA + Optimize pack. Target expansion to APAC in Q4 once residency + network peering validated.

Next short notes: "Buyer likes the idea of automatic prefix caching — 'if you can cut tokens by 20% during customer intros that helps our unit economics'". Short-term ask: run a 48h spike test with 3x synthetic concurrent load (SE action item).
